label: Text 1
transcript: The class read short extracts from Zeynep Tufekci's Twitter and Tear Gas (2017) and Tim Wu's The Attention Merchants (2016). Mr. Yilmaz framed the question: what is the difference between public opinion and aggregated platform behaviour? The class noticed quickly that the answer is not nothing and not everything.
